the development of a high-performance acquisition-analysis system for a segmented gamma-ray calorimeter that can be used to measure (n,/spl gamma/) cross-sections.
developing a high-performance, high-availability, distributed data acquisition and analysis system for a large, segmented BaF/sub 4/ gamma-ray calorimeters.
the development of a system for acquiring data from the BaF/sub 1/2/ detector, and then processing that data to reconstruct the energy of gamma-rays and their directions of emission.

we have developed and implemented a complete acquisition-analysis framework for DANCE.

the use of waveform digitization in a high-data rate experiment is feasible and can provide significant benefits.
